increased in duration for the following rivers in Ohio...

record.

* WHEN...Until Wednesday evening.

are flooded. At 34.0 feet, Several areas near the river are
flooded. Homes, farmland, camps, several sections of Route 60, and
secondary roads near the river are flooded.

- At 2:45 PM EDT Tuesday the stage was 26.5 feet.

this afternoon to a crest of 34.0 feet just after midnight
tonight. It will then fall below flood stage tomorrow afternoon.
- Flood stage is 29.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 34.8
feet on 04/03/2024.
